# What can you pay for this flip?

> Free fix and flip calculator for house flippers. Enter ARV, purchase price, rehab and hard-money terms to get profit, cash needed, return on cash, the maximum allowable offer, the break-even sale price and how profit changes with price and time on the market. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
